items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill - the audit agent still leads the day
items.summary:
a coding-agent skill that runs multi-phase security audits and verifies each finding before it reports it, still the fastest riser on trending.
2,874 stars in the last day, up from 2,264 this morning; javascript, mit, 46.2k total.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio - the local elevenlabs clone, 646 languages
items.summary:
a fully local voice stack for cloning, dubbing, dictation and audiobooks, pitched as the open-source answer to elevenlabs.
1,588 stars today and 86.1k total; python, agpl-3.0, and the biggest new entry of the evening.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark - the anti-slop design skill keeps climbing
items.summary:
a design skill that forces claude code, cursor and codex to make pages that do not look machine-made.
1,359 stars today against 455 this morning, 33.2k total; css, mit.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable - a design language for your ai harness
items.summary:
the design rules packaged as skills so an agent stops producing the same generic page.
1,113 stars today, 87.3k total, the largest repo in this list; rust, apache-2.0.

items.title: Zagitta/gpu-unlock - a kernel module that doubles fp/bf16 issue rate on rtx 30-series
items.summary:
a linux module that writes the professional cards' speed selectors before the nvidia driver binds, lifting fp/bf16 fma issue rate on ga102-ga106 chips.
the author's 3090 ti numbers: bf16 87.5 to 157.4 tflops, tf32 42.6 to 82.6; 5,594 stars since the repo appeared on october 18, and number one on trendshift.

items.title: makecindy/cindy - an agent pitched at people who do not want setup
items.summary:
an open-source agent that claims to work out of the box without wiring keys, tools and config first.
677 stars today on 4.6k total, so it is still rising off a small base; typescript, apache-2.0.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck - a desk-sized biped from the reachy lab
items.summary:
an open biped robot small enough to sit on a desk, from the french lab behind reachy.
657 stars today and 11.4k total; rust, apache-2.0, the hobby branch of the robotics boom.

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents - a multi-agent trading desk in a repo
items.summary:
a framework that splits trading research across analyst, researcher and trader agents that argue before a decision.
309 stars today on 114.2k total, an older project resurfacing on trendshift at 25; python, apache-2.0.

items.title: qatar's mediators are in tehran and washington still will not answer yes or no
items.summary:
qatari mediators are in tehran while trump kept the strike open, saying the us could go 'maybe tomorrow' and still holding out a 'big, beautiful' deal.
centcom has options ready for hegseth, but a report this morning says the planning is aimed at after the november 3 midterms.
items.change: mediation moved to qatari mediators inside tehran, and the reported centcom options are now dated to after the midterms rather than to today.

items.title: riyadh's airport reopened while saudi air defences cleared a barrage
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition says it destroyed two drones and a ballistic missile aimed at riyadh, ten ballistic missiles over the south and a cruise missile at khamis mushait.
king khalid airport reopened terminal 2 for international flights on sunday, hours after the houthis told airlines and travellers it is a military target.
items.change: the barrage that started saturday night ran to sunday midday, and riyadh's main airport took international flights again for the first time since the october 10 strike.

items.title: netanyahu posts a mushroom cloud over tel aviv two days before the vote
items.summary:
netanyahu's instagram carried an ai image of a nuclear blast over what looks like tel aviv, with a caption saying israel faces an existential threat from iran.
the idf will shut every west bank land crossing on tuesday and bar palestinian workers from settlements from sunday, and yair golan told voters the prime minister has lost it.
items.change: the last campaign weekend turned from a tel aviv rally into a war-panic post from the prime minister, plus a total closure of the west bank for polling day.

meta.crossings: all west bank land crossings closed tuesday

items.title: israel seals the hebron attackers' homes and warns 1,300 more will lose theirs
items.summary:
the idf sealed off the homes of the two gunmen who killed two soldiers on friday, ahead of demolition, and picked up 12 more suspects in hebron overnight.
the city's mayor tells reuters about 1,200 people are already displaced and another 1,300 are at risk, while physicians for human rights reports patients stuck at checkpoints.
items.change: from a mass evacuation to steps that look permanent: the attackers' homes are sealed for demolition and the city is counting who loses a home next.

items.title: jordan buries eight of its nine dead, with the prime minister in the crowd
items.summary:
thousands followed coffins wrapped in jordanian flags past st george's church in karak province on sunday, with pm jafar hassan, ministers and senior officers attending.
nine people were killed when gunmen opened fire on a funeral there on friday; the ninth victim is buried on monday after three days of national mourning.
items.change: the toll has settled at nine, the burials began on sunday, and the government declared three days of mourning with the prime minister present.

items.title: three guards killed at gaza's islamic university, hours after a drone hit the same campus
items.summary:
an israeli air strike killed three security guards at the islamic university in gaza city, the second attack on the compound in a few hours, after a drone strike injured seven female students.
seven palestinians were killed across gaza on sunday, with shelling in al-mawasi and a strike near hamad hospital; unesco says about 95% of gaza's university campuses are damaged or destroyed.
items.change: new this build: the university compound was hit twice in one day and the day's toll across gaza reached seven.

items.title: taiz is short of dialysis inside the siege, and yemen's army claims 736 strikes in a day
items.summary:
a rights group says 1,110 kidney patients in taiz need about 120 dialysis sessions a day, with 192 people in intensive care and 154 children in incubators three weeks into the houthi siege.
forces loyal to the recognised government say they hit 736 houthi positions in 24 hours and 'neutralised' 307 fighters, a claim nobody independent has confirmed.
items.change: new this build: the first hard medical numbers out of taiz, and the government's own count of its biggest day of strikes.

items.title: tehran widens its target list to gulf energy and airports
items.summary:
iran has warned publicly and through diplomatic channels that a new campaign would bring strikes on gas pipelines, airports and civilian infrastructure around the gulf, per a wall street journal report cited by the jerusalem post.
parliament's foreign affairs chair asked for permission to use 'deterrent weapons, including nuclear', and to suspend npt cooperation if the us attacks.
items.change: new this build: the threat list now names gulf pipelines, airports and civilian sites, and a nuclear option was raised by name in parliament.

meta.reported_by: Wall Street Journal via Jerusalem Post

items.title: futures reopen in about six hours and the weekend gave them nothing but iran
items.summary:
cash markets are shut and the last prints are still friday's: s&p 7,623.68, nasdaq 25,955.34, dow 52,215.16, vix 19.45.
equity and oil futures open at 6pm et, 1am in riyadh, with brent already at a six-month high and trump refusing to rule out a strike.

items.title: the shipping war now has an oil slick on uae beaches
items.summary:
a tanker holed during this month's surge of strikes in the hormuz is leaking, and satellite imagery reviewed by bbc verify shows the slick spreading more than 35km before washing ashore near umm al quwain.
the uae says containment began thursday; the market side of the same war is brent at $116.72, its highest settle since april 29.

items.title: france's protests are smaller than last week but the borrowing cost is not
items.summary:
the interior ministry counted 410,000 demonstrators as clashes returned for a second weekend, with water cannon in paris and looting in marseille and lyon.
the violence was less intense than last week, but the 10-year yield went above 5% for the first time since 2002 and settled near 5.03% on friday.

items.title: the busiest earnings week of the quarter lands on the fed's decision
items.summary:
the fomc decides wednesday, q3 gdp and september pce follow on thursday at 8:30am et, and more than a third of the s&p 500 reports this week.
alphabet and microsoft go wednesday after the close, amazon thursday, and exxon, abbvie and chevron close the week on friday.

items.title: wall street ends the week lower as the ai trade wobbles
items.summary:
the s&p fell 0.52% to 7,623.68 on friday and 0.47% on the week; the nasdaq lost 0.21% to 25,955.34 and 0.71% on the week.
the dow slipped 1.24% on friday but still gained 0.41% for the week; the vix closed at 19.45.

items.title: nvidia's role as the ai financier hits its first stress test
items.summary:
nvidia carries $36bn of off-balance-sheet backstops for neoclouds plus a guarantee of up to $105bn for openai's ohio site, and the credit market is now pricing the risk.
coreweave, nebius and iren are down at least 30% this month, coreweave's cds spread is past 11%, and firmus pulled its ipo.

items.title: gold lost 4.1% in a week when a war premium was building in oil
items.summary:
gold closed at $4,007.90, down 1.3% on friday and 4.1% on the week, even as brent added 6.2% on iran strike risk.
the divergence is the tell for monday: either the war bid pulls gold back or positioning keeps unwinding into the fed.

items.title: robert half jumped 22% on a q3 beat while lkq lost a fifth of its value
items.summary:
robert half closed up 21.7% at $45.87, the s&p's biggest gainer, after third-quarter earnings beat estimates and calmed margin fears.
lkq fell 22.5% to $17.42 on weak preliminary results and an ousted chief executive; corcept dropped 20.1%, bloom energy 11.2% and credo 9.5%.

items.title: liverpool 2-0 brighton: an own goal, an isak tap-in, and fourth place
items.summary:
wirtz's low strike went in off pascal gross and isak finished barcola's cross four minutes later, giving liverpool their first home league win since april.
the win lifts them to fourth, above chelsea, with four changes from villarreal: isak, wirtz, kerkez and barcola back in the xi.

items.title: bbc ratings: barcola and wirtz 8, isak 7, and a clean sheet for alisson
items.summary:
bbc gave barcola and wirtz an 8, crediting barcola with the cross for isak and wirtz with the shot that became the opener.
isak's finish was his sixth premier league goal in as many games, and alisson's clean sheet came with one scare when ayari hit the post after a loose pass.

items.title: wirtz forced the opener and came off after treatment
items.summary:
wirtz's shot deflected in off gross for the first goal, the moment iraola had been asking for after a week of defending his body language.
he came off on 65 minutes shortly after receiving treatment, with nyoni on, so the fitness question now matters more than the form one.

items.title: ngumoha got the last 13 minutes this time
items.summary:
rio ngumoha replaced barcola on 77 minutes with the game already won, a smaller role than his midweek breakthrough against villarreal.
koumas came on for isak at the same time, and iraola now has barcola fit and isak scoring, which is why the teenager waits.

items.title: chelsea at anfield on wednesday, and palmer is suspended for it
items.summary:
liverpool host chelsea in the carabao cup on wednesday, and chelsea will be without cole palmer after his two yellow cards at tottenham.
xabi alonso's side arrive at anfield with the home drought just ended and liverpool fourth in the league.

items.title: szoboszlai is out, munoz is a doubt, and gravenberch is available again
items.summary:
szoboszlai is out with the hamstring problem he aggravated at brentford, munoz is a doubt with the knock from the same game, and barcola trained normally after sitting out thursday.
gravenberch is back after serving a one-match league ban, while bradley, ekitike and leoni stay long-term absentees and endo and chiesa return to the squad.

items.title: liverpool tell valencia they will trigger otorbi's £25m clause
items.summary:
liverpool have contacted valencia to say they intend to activate the £25m exit clause of right winger david otorbi, according to a teamtalk report carried on the club's media watch page.
valencia have taken steps to block the exit; reliability: one outlet, unconfirmed by either club.
